Name: CreditWorthy
Prompt: Submit a short essay about what you learned and how the Credit Worthy program by OneMain Financial has made an impact on you.

Name: Teen Navigate
Prompt: Describe a personal experience that shaped how you think about money, opportunity, or financial responsibility. This could involve your family, work, school, or something you observed in your community. Explain what you learned from that experience and how it influences your goals for the future.

Name: Broad Horizons
Prompt: What is something you’ve done in the past year to broaden your horizons?

Name: Golden Future
Prompt: Tell us about your educational and career goals and objectives.*(200) + We believe people can achieve more together than they ever can alone, that is why we created the New York Life Golden Futures Scholarship. Please tell us what you have learned while working through the NYL modules. How will this help you achieve your further educational and financial goals? What processes or best practices will you use to be more financially prepared to move into the world on your own? Who will you need by your side to achieve these goals?(250)

Name: Abbott & Fenner

Name: Regions Riding Forward

Name: Andrew S Mather
Prompt: Provide a 500-word minimum essay on the value of hard work and what it has taught you

Name: Daniel G Calugar
Prompt: Aspirations Essay AND From 1950 to 2007, the annual average ratio of federal debt to GDP was 45%, and that ratio was 45% in 2007 as well. In September 2025, the US federal debt was 125% of GDP. Is the current level of US federal debt to GDP, and the trend for that ratio to increase from 2007 forward, a problem that needs to be addressed? If so, how would you recommend that it be addressed? If the current ratio and the trend over the past 15 years is not a problem, what level would you consider problematic and why?

Name: Headyway Book Lovers
Prompt: Leadership Paragraph, Goals Paragraph, and Essay about nonfiction book

Name: Money Matters
Prompt: Submit an essay (1,000 words or less) or video (1-2 minutes inStudents with tablet length) showcasing your understanding of paycheck knowledge and the importance of mastering paycheck basics. The topic for the contest is: Why does understanding your paycheck matter, and how can it help set you up for a stronger financial future? Feel free to share personal examples.

Name: ACF Visionary
Prompt: 500-word essay on “Why College is Important to Me”

Name: All Good Deeds
Prompt: Please write an essay of 150 words or fewer describing a good deed that you have done. The deed may be at the personal, local, community, or any level. It may be a one-time good deed or an ongoing one. You may choose to describe why the deed was important to you or the impact that it had.
